value.signature: fn enter_command_scope (& self , command_name : & str) -> Scope

exception.justification: Justified: This entry-origin adapter lends the existing root identity to a contextual span without creating another operation.

review.body: { let ticket = RootHandoff { observation : Arc :: as_ptr (& self . operation . observation . next_id) as usize , root_id : self . operation . id , } ; let span = with_root_handoff (ticket , | | command_scope_span (command_name)) ; Scope (span . entered ()) }
review.item_premise: This lease arms a same-thread private ticket only during construction of its command span, then enters the span after disarming; the lease alone owns root completion.
